set_by: Portfolio owner, chosen before any backtest on real market data was run
rules_of_use: Development backtests (any rule version) only simulate and report dates before sealed_from.
A rule version may be evaluated on the sealed period only after it passed the development criteria (backtest_criteria.json) for that horizon.
Each rule version and horizon gets exactly one holdout evaluation; its result is final and stored immutably.
BUY/SELL become candidates only for a rule version and horizon that passed both the development criteria and the holdout criteria.

definitions.window: sealed_from to the latest available trading day. Indicators may use earlier history (data up to each day only); trading starts on sealed_from with fresh capital.
definitions.min_excess_cagr: Strategy CAGR minus Nifty 50 buy-and-hold CAGR over the holdout window, after costs and taxes.
definitions.max_drawdown: Strategy maximum drawdown over the holdout window must not be larger than Nifty 50's.
definitions.min_trades: Closed round-trip trades inside the holdout window, including positions closed at the end.
definitions.regimes: Not tested on the holdout: two years cannot contain three distinct calendar-year regimes.
